title: The AI RAM Shortage Is Also Driving Up SSD Prices
summary: The Verge reported that AI-driven memory demand is reducing consumer NAND and SSD availability, with NVMe SSD prices doubling or tripling since late 2025 and premium drives seeing steep price increases.

title: AI Data Center Memory Demand Raises Shortage Concerns
summary: Industry groups warned that AI data center deployments are consuming a growing share of memory output, increasing shortage and pricing risk for downstream sectors.

title: PC Industry Reconsiders DDR4 as DDR5 Supply Tightens
summary: PC component vendors are preparing more DDR4 products as AI demand tightens DDR5 availability and reshapes consumer memory supply planning.

title: SK hynix Plans Major Memory Capacity Expansion
summary: SK hynix signaled plans to expand wafer capacity over several years while indicating AI-driven memory tightness may persist.

title: TSMC Says Customer Demand Will Take Time to Satisfy
summary: TSMC leadership indicated that customer demand remains difficult to satisfy, reinforcing capacity pressure across advanced semiconductor supply chains.

title: Samsung Shows HBM5 Mockup as AI Memory Competition Intensifies
summary: Samsung displayed HBM5 technology work, underscoring continued competition and investment in AI-oriented high-bandwidth memory.

title: Apple Can't Seem to Keep Mac Minis in Stock As Demand Heats Up
summary: Business Insider reported that Apple's base M4 Mac Mini sold out online in the US, with some configurations showing long wait times as memory demand and local AI use cases supported stronger consumer hardware demand.
